affected_subject.reason: Identifies DynamicSwapFeeModule.getFee() and CLFactory.getSwapFee() with their fee caps.

trigger_or_action.reason: Dynamically calculated fee above 100,000 (10%) is rejected by CLFactory.getSwapFee().

direct_effect.reason: Fee above 10% rejected, falling back to default tick spacing fee, losing discounts and anti-MEV cap.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Conflicting caps (500,000 vs 100,000) establish expected-vs-actual mismatch; mitigation states alignment requirement.

summary: Report identifies affected fee functions, the trigger (fee >10% rejected), direct effect (fallback to default fee), and a concrete cap-conflict safety relation.
